title: Concordance sample-pair schema
description: Schema for the CSVs provided with params.concordance_highpass_lowpass_pairs and params.concordance_axiom_lowpass_pairs. Each row is one Picard GenotypeConcordance comparison. Sample IDs allow both string and integer JSON types because nf-schema's CSV reader infers the type from content — an all-digit ID (e.g. an Axiom sample ID) is parsed as an integer regardless of quoting in the CSV.

pair_id.errorMessage: Pair ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces (used as the output file prefix).

call_sample.errorMessage: Call sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces.

truth_sample.errorMessage: Truth sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces.
